eyebrow: Applying the test, table by table

steps.label: Quantity
steps.sub: becomes a property on that relationship

code:
CREATE (c:Customer {customerId: 1, name: 'Ana'})
CREATE (p:Product {productId: 101, name: 'Widget'})
CREATE (o:Order {orderId: 5001})
CREATE (c)-[:PLACED]->(o)
CREATE (o)-[:CONTAINS {quantity: 3}]->(p)
caption: No OrderItems node, no foreign key columns — just a typed, property-bearing relationship.
